title: Step 68-D Product and Variant create edit lifecycle sales administration
description: Implement only the HIGH-risk Admin product and variant create/edit/lifecycle surface on top of canonical Step 68-C. Use source-proven Catalog operations for product create/update/publish/archive/unarchive/stop-resume sales and variant create/update/stop-resume sales. Preserve server-owned authorization, exact Product If-Match concurrency, non-retry mutation semantics, explicit 202 accepted/unknown handling and server re-read after mutation. Attribute structure administration, Brand/Category mutation, Media, Sales-Control bulk controls and all Step69 pricing/inventory/Excel work remain out of scope.

dependencies.evidence: PR #363 terminally closed with exact-SHA Canonical CI #1905, Phase A #1404, CodeQL #1055 and Lock release comment 6204515193.

acceptance_criteria.description: Product create/update/publish/archive/unarchive/stop-sales/resume-sales use only canonical Admin Catalog endpoints through the existing server auth bridge; no browser credential authority or ad-hoc transport is introduced.

Product update sends the exact loaded Product version through canonical If-Match and 409 conflicts fail closed with an explicit re-read path; no silent overwrite or automatic conflict retry is allowed.
Product archive requires an explicit reason, archived products expose no edit/publish/resume action, and unarchive is represented as returning to draft without silently resuming sales.
Publish is server-authoritative: the frontend does not reproduce active-variant or sellable-price business rules and displays canonical 409/422 outcomes without claiming success.
Variant create/update/stop-resume sales use only source-proven fields and endpoints. Pricing, inventory and attribute-structure mutation remain outside 68-D.

Unsafe POST/PATCH mutations are never automatically retried. Any canonical 202 accepted result is treated as non-final and followed by authoritative read/manual follow-up rather than fabricated success.
All Admin form actions enforce same-origin submission, bounded inputs and neutral 401/403 handling; field-level canonical errors may be rendered without raw backend messages.
The product/variant lifecycle UI is Persian RTL, responsive and keyboard accessible, uses explicit destructive action review, and restores focus/revalidates after authoritative mutation outcomes.

No Attribute/Brand/Category mutation, Media mutation, Sales-Control bulk apply, pricing/inventory/Excel work, Backend/OpenAPI/database/generated-contract change, Storefront change, Product Design mutation or Current-State closure update is introduced.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review, Independent Security PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock and explicit Project Owner Human Gate approval, followed by protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 68-D is HIGH risk. Project Owner Human Gate is mandatory on the final exact HEAD and Artifact only. Stage 68-E remains blocked until terminal canonical closure.
